name: Pairwise Sums
description: You are given an array of n integers. For each element output the sum of itself and the previous element. For the first element, output the sum of the first and the last elements of the array.
input_specification: The input consists of a single line of space-separated integers. The first number is n ( 2 ≤ n ≤ 50 ) — the size of the array. The following n numbers are the elements of the array ( 1 ≤ a i ≤ 1000 ).
output_specification: Output the sums a 1 + a n , a 2 + a 1 , ..., a n + a n - 1 , separated with spaces.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
